title: Voice Lint concept revision
summary: Voice Studio Preview 0.2: live Angular applications with original content/component sources, Markdown folders and explicit Coding-Agent-Runner semantic review. Current implementation: local Angular frontend, .NET backend and embeddable @voice/review JavaScript library. Website and Markdown example projects, project/file reports, durable feedback and guarded source changes. Includes model roles, Voice-specific quality evidence and Token Economy routing responsibilities. Implementation status and verification are recorded at the top of the dossier; earlier research is preserved.
